declarations.name: Gauge
declarations.description: Probe for the `_controlled` ELEMENT SCOPE (NB2h): declares `reading` but is OUTSIDE the roster entry's scope, so `reading` REFLECTS here — the <button>/<data>/<option> case, where the IDL attribute is a reflected DOMString and the content attribute is both correct and SSR-visible.

attributes.name: reading
attributes.description: Reflected content attribute on this element; the live property belongs to wc-widget alone.

declarations.name: Dial
declarations.description: Probe for CAPABILITY-ROW DIVERGENCE (NB2i): declares the same `reading` HTML attribute, but its value SPACE is a number, so it must not share the `reading` row at all — config `_renames` + `attrTypes` give it `readingNumeric : Float`. The <progress>/<meter> case, whose IDL `value` is a restricted `double` that answers a non-finite string with a TypeError.

attributes.name: reading
attributes.description: Numeric reading. A string property write against this element's `double` IDL attribute is a Web IDL TypeError, so this element leaves the shared `reading` row.
